QuestInfo.name: Kyrin's Second Orders
QuestInfo.0: You delivered #b#p1092003#k's gifts to #b#p1090000#k. You've met her before, but the captain of the Nautilus is as charasmatic as ever. She might have a mission--a REAL Pirate mission--for you!
QuestInfo.1: #b#p1090000##k congratulates you on a job well done aboard the Nautilus. She wants you to help #b#p1092007##k now.
QuestInfo.2: You went to see #b#p1092007##k. He looked worried about something...

0.0: I heard you've been helping my mangy crew out with their troubles. Good on you for that. I had a feeling you'd make a fine Pirate. Anyway, I've got a mission for you. Go see #b#p1092007##k for the details. \r\n

yes.0: #b#p1092007##k has an important matter he needs help with. Report to him immediately.

no.0: This is an order from the captain, not some silly errand.

1.0: Did that sound like a request? No, because it was an order. Get your head on straight!

yes.0: Captain #b#p1090000##k sent you, hm? Good timing.

npc.0: Hurry up and go see Muirhat.
